title: Saudi VC 9M 2026: two deals carry the headline
sources: MAGNiTT KSA Venture Capital Q3 2026 update; entARABI, 5 Nov 2026

slides.title: $1B raised.
slides.sub: What the headline hides, in 6 slides.

slides.label: Raised by Saudi startups in the first nine months of 2026
slides.note: 113 deals. Funding down 29% and deal count down 39% on the same period last year.

slides.label: Two mega rounds, 56% of the total
slides.note: Take them out and the rest of the market is back at 9M 2024 levels.

bars.label: Funding outside the two mega rounds

slides.eyebrow: Three things I'd take from it
slides.title: Read past the total
points: Two rounds worth $563M carry the headline. The rest is back at 9M 2024 levels.
International investors pulled back the most, so more depends on how steadily local funds deploy.
Series A held up better (-17%). Companies with traction are still raising.

slides.text: Next quarter I'll watch non-mega funding before the headline total.
slides.question: Founders and fund managers: does this match your pipeline?
